camps: Campgrounds: Berlin-Ichthyosaur campground. Sites: 14 units; some suitable for RVs up to 25 ft; fire rings, BBQ grills, covered tables, water seasonally, restrooms, dump station. Open: Year-round camping; water generally mid-April through October

Campgrounds: Dayton campground. Sites: 10 campsites suitable for RVs up to 34 feet; picnic tables and barbecues; dump station and flush toilets. Open: Park open year-round

Campgrounds: Main campground; Scout Camp dispersed camping; group camping area. Sites: Main campground: 20 sites for tents/RVs, no hookups; dump station near entrance. Campgrounds: Main campground; 4 first-come, first-served tent-only sites. Sites: 16-unit campground; all 16 sites have 30A and 50A power and water hookups; 4 additional tent-only first-come, first-served sites within campground loop. Open: Campground accessible 24/7; individual site water hookups shut off seasonally around late October to early April, weather dependent

Campgrounds: Atlatl Rock Campground; Arch Rock Campground; group-use campsites. Sites: Two campgrounds with 72 units combined; RV sites with power and water hookups. Three group-use campsites, each up to 45 people. Open: Annual full park closure Dec. 1–14; camping reservations unavailable during closure. Location: park street address (29450 Valley of Fire Rd, Overton, NV 89040), placed by the US Census geocoder
Campgrounds: Willow Creek Campground; group camping facility. Sites: Two large pull-through RV spaces plus additional spaces for other camping types. Open: Park open year-round

Campgrounds: Washoe Lake Campground; equestrian group camping area. Sites: 49 sites total; Loop A has 24 sites, all with water and utility hookups. Group/equestrian camping also available. Open: Campground open year-round
